title: Realtor.ca Property Scraper
description: Extract property listings from Realtor.ca. Provide a Realtor.ca map URL or use keyword and location filters.

startUrl.title: Realtor.ca URL
startUrl.description: A Realtor.ca map/search URL. URL filters are used first when provided.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional keyword filter such as condo, waterfront, garage, or an MLS number.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city shortcut when no URL is provided. Supported examples: Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of property listings to save.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are recommended for Realtor.ca.
